content: Homebrew formula for SwiftPM executables: official homebrew/core pattern (SwiftLint, SwiftFormat) builds from source using 'system "swift", "build", *std_swift_args' then 'bin.install'. For pre-built binary distribution via custom tap (needed for macOS-only tools that can't meet homebrew/core's Linux requirement), use a Formula in a 'homebrew-<repo>' GitHub repo: 'brew tap user/repo' clones github.com/user/homebrew-repo. The formula downloads a tarball from GitHub Releases with sha256 verification and installs via bin.install. homebrew/core rejects macOS-only tools — custom tap is the only path for scip-swift.
